output.reason: The release note [ev-c54ac338953d] says only that `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` was promoted to Beta. It does not say whether the gate is now on by default or what finalizer behaviour changes. In the same section, the NameConstraints promotion [ev-619c0cea3aa4] states "(enabled by default)" explicitly, which this item does not. So the evidence does not show whether exposed environments are those that leave the gate unset (if the default flipped) or none at all. The proposed condition `feature-gate enabled` also flags environments that already turned the gate on before this release and see no change. Before this can be decided, we need upstream text (for example, the feature-gate documentation or PR #7488) that gives the Beta default and the resulting finalizer-name change.
